'''Hyperthermia''' was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]]. It could be bestowed upon an individual after several [[Standard year/Legends|months]] of attunement to a [[Spinel crystal|spinel]] [[tasar crystal]]. Hyperthermia allowed the individual to perceive minute temperature differences in objects. The ability could also be used to find inanimate objects in the dark, as well as being a diagnostic aid for healing.<ref name="J15" />
